allow_indexed-tips: Whether to allow search engines to index and crawl site files
allow_mounted-tips: Whether to display and permit access to mounted storages
announcement-tips: Markdown announcement banner displayed at the top of the homepage
aria2_secret-tips: Secret token for accessing Aria2 JSON-RPC service
aria2_uri-tips: JSON-RPC endpoint address for Aria2, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:6800/jsonrpc
audio_autoplay-tips: Automatically start playing audio when opening audio details page
audio_cover-tips: Default cover image URL when audio file lacks embedded album artwork
audio_types-tips: File extensions supported for audio player preview (comma-separated)
auto_update_index-tips: Automatically update search index when files change
copy_task_threads_num-tips: Number of concurrent worker threads for file copy operations
customize_body-tips: Custom HTML/JS analytics code injected before </body>
decompress_download_task_threads_num-tip: Concurrent worker threads for downloading archives to decompress
decompress_upload_task_threads_num-tips: Concurrent worker threads for uploading extracted files
default_page_size-tips: Number of files loaded per page in pagination or scroll mode
external_previews-tips: JSON rules for third-party preview launch actions in toolbar
favicon-tips: Website favicon image URL displayed in browser tabs
filename_char_mapping-tips: JSON mapping of invalid characters to replacement strings when storing files
filter_readme_scripts-tips: Filter out potentially dangerous script tags when rendering README.md
forward_direct_link_params-tips: Forward URL query parameters to the upstream storage direct URL
ftp_implicit_tls-tips: Whether FTP server enables implicit FTPS protocol
ftp_mandatory_tls-tips: Whether FTP server requires explicit TLS encryption
ftp_pasv_port_map-tips: Passive mode port range for FTP data connections, e.g. 50000-50050
ftp_public_host-tips: Public IP or domain address sent to clients for passive FTP connections
ftp_tls_private_key_path-tips: Absolute filesystem path to the TLS private key file
ftp_tls_public_cert_path-tips: Absolute filesystem path to the TLS public certificate file
handle_hook_after_writing-tips: Trigger directory metadata refresh hook after uploads or edits
handle_hook_rate_limit-tips: Rate limit for directory hook traversal requests (0 for unlimited)
hide_files-tips: Regular expressions of files or folders to hide from standard visitors
hide_storage_details-tips: Hide storage driver details and usage breakdown in homepage footer
hide_storage_details_in_manage_page: Hide Storage Details in Manage Page
hide_storage_details_in_manage_page-tips: Hide storage driver internal details in admin panel
home_container-tips: Max-width container style for homepage file listing area
home_icon-tips: Emoji or icon text displayed next to root folder in navigation
iframe_previews-tips: JSON configuration for iframe-embedded online document preview engines
ignore_direct_link_params-tips: URL query parameters ignored during direct link signature checks
ignore_paths-tips: Paths excluded during search index scanning (one per line)
ignore_system_files-tips: When enabled, ignores common system files (.DS_Store, desktop.ini, Thumbs.db, ._*) during upload
image_types-tips: File extensions supported for image lightbox preview (comma-separated)
ldap_default_dir-tips: Default root path for newly created LDAP users
ldap_default_permission-tips: Initial permission bitmask integer for new LDAP users (0 for read-only)
ldap_login_enabled-tips: Enable LDAP / Active Directory unified authentication
ldap_login_tips-tips: Helpful guidance text shown on the LDAP login tab
ldap_manager_dn-tips: Manager account binding DN with user query permissions, e.g. cn=admin,dc=example,dc=org
ldap_manager_password-tips: Password for the manager binding account
ldap_server-tips: LDAP server address and port, e.g. ldap://127.0.0.1:389
ldap_skip_tls_verify-tips: Skip TLS certificate validation when connecting to LDAPS servers
ldap_user_search_base-tips: Base DN for querying users, e.g. ou=users,dc=example,dc=org
ldap_user_search_filter-tips: Search filter expression to match login usernames, e.g. (uid=%s) or (sAMAccountName=%s)
link_expiration-tips: Direct download link signature validity duration in seconds (0 for permanent)
logo-tips: Site logo URL (multi-line text: line 1 for light mode, line 2 for dark mode)
main_color-tips: Primary brand accent color in Hex code (e.g. #6366f1)
max_client_download_speed-tips: Maximum download rate per client (KiB/s, -1 for unlimited)
max_client_upload_speed-tips: Maximum upload rate per client (KiB/s, -1 for unlimited)
max_index_depth-tips: Maximum recursive subfolder depth when building search index
max_server_download_speed-tips: Global download speed limit for the entire server (KiB/s, -1 for unlimited)
max_server_upload_speed-tips: Global upload speed limit for the entire server (KiB/s, -1 for unlimited)
multipart_chunk_size-tips: Chunk size for multipart uploads in MB; keep under your CDN limit
multipart_enabled-tips: Whether to permit chunked multipart uploads for large files
non_efs_zip_encoding-tips: Fallback character encoding for non-UTF8 legacy ZIP files (e.g. IBM437 or GBK)
ocr_api-tips: API endpoint for OCR optical character recognition and scanning
offline_download_task_threads_num-tips: Max concurrent worker threads for offline download tasks
offline_download_transfer_task_threads_n: Concurrent worker threads for transferring completed downloads to storages
package_download-tips: Allow users to batch download multiple selected files as a ZIP package
pagination_type-tips: Data loading and pagination style for file listings
preview_archives_by_default-tips: Open archive tree preview by default instead of triggering direct download
preview_download_by_default-tips: Force direct download when previewing files
privacy_regs-tips: Regular expressions to mask sensitive private data in server logs
proxy_ignore_headers-tips: HTTP headers stripped during server-side proxy stream forwarding (comma-separated)
proxy_types-tips: File types forcefully proxied through OpenList server (e.g. m3u8,url)
qbittorrent_seedtime-tips: Seed time in minutes after qBittorrent downloads complete (0 for unlimited)
qbittorrent_url-tips: qBittorrent WebUI endpoint URL, e.g. http://admin:adminadmin@127.0.0.1:8080
readme_autorender-tips: Automatically render and display README.md at the top of current folder
robots_txt-tips: Robots.txt protocol rules configured for search engine crawlers
s3_access_key_id-tips: Access Key ID for connecting to the OpenList S3 gateway
s3_buckets-tips: Bucket mappings exported by the OpenList S3 server (JSON format)
s3_secret_access_key-tips: Secret Access Key for connecting to the OpenList S3 gateway
settings_layout-tips: Layout presentation style for admin settings forms
sftp_disable_password_login-tips: Require public key authentication and disable password logins on SFTP server
share_archive_preview-tips: Allow anonymous visitors to preview archive files on share links
share_force_proxy-tips: Force proxy share downloads through server to obscure raw storage URLs
share_icon-tips: Emoji or icon text displayed on share links and pages
share_preview-tips: Allow anonymous visitors to preview shared documents, media, and images
share_preview_archives_by_default-tips: Open archive preview tree by default on share links
share_preview_download_by_default-tips: Trigger direct download by default on share links
share_summary_content-tips: Handlebars template for copying share link summaries to clipboard
show_disk_usage_in_plain_text: Show Disk Usage in Plain Text
show_disk_usage_in_plain_text-tips: Display storage usage in plain readable text instead of progress bars
sign_all-tips: Require valid HMAC signature parameters on all direct download links
site_title-tips: Global title displayed across the entire website
sso_application_name-tips: Application name registered in Casdoor or identity provider
sso_auto_register-tips: Automatically create an OpenList account upon first successful SSO login
sso_client_id-tips: Application Client ID assigned by your OAuth2 / OIDC provider
sso_client_secret-tips: Application Client Secret assigned by your OAuth2 / OIDC provider
sso_compatibility_mode-tips: Enable legacy compatibility for older SSO callback protocols
sso_default_dir-tips: Default root path for newly registered SSO users
sso_default_permission-tips: Initial permission bitmask integer for new SSO users
sso_endpoint_name-tips: Endpoint hostname or Base URL of the SSO provider
sso_extra_scopes-tips: Additional OAuth2 scopes requested during authorization (comma or space separated)
sso_jwt_public_key-tips: RSA public key content for verifying SSO JWT token signatures
sso_login_enabled-tips: Enable OAuth2 / OIDC single sign-on authentication
sso_login_platform-tips: Identity provider protocol used for single sign-on
sso_oidc_username_key-tips: Payload key name to extract username from OIDC Token (default name or preferred_username)
sso_organization_name-tips: Organization name defined in Casdoor platform
text_types-tips: File extensions supported for code and text editor preview (comma-separated)
transmission_seedtime-tips: Seed time in minutes after Transmission downloads complete (0 for unlimited)
upload_task_threads_num-tips: Concurrent worker threads for file upload operations
video_autoplay-tips: Automatically start video playback upon opening video details page
video_types-tips: File extensions supported for HTML5 video playback (comma-separated)
webauthn_login_enabled-tips: Enable passwordless WebAuthn / Passkey biometric login
